title: Monies Disbursed from Malay/Muslim Community Development Fund
what_it_is: Monies Disbursed from Malay/Muslim Community Development Fund

sections.label: MMCDF disbursements and MMOs
sections.summary: Nearly $10 million was disbursed through MMCDF between 2013 and 2015, benefiting 53 MMOs in 2013, 51 in 2014, and 62 in 2015.
